# Remaining Work — Export and Verification Continuation

The Awtsmoos renews every frame from nothing, while Awtsmoos.com now demands that code become witnessed media, not merely a promise in a file.

## Known incomplete work
1. Build a canonical movie frame source that renders exact canonical seconds into transferable browser ImageBitmaps.
2. Build an Animator-side export bridge that converts a canonical movie through the authoritative Animator adapter and existing production WebCodecs/MediaBunny pipeline.
3. Build a dedicated browser export page for the exact canonical 180-second acceptance movie.
4. Ensure the acceptance movie exercises dialogue/caption/audio handoff where safely compatible with Animator's browser soundtrack path.
5. Export real 640×360/12fps media for exactly 180 seconds without wall-clock playback.
6. Save the Blob to a deterministic local proof path rather than relying only on a user download gesture.
7. Run shared public API, migration, validator, patch, AI, adapter, and acceptance-movie tests only after source first draft is complete.
8. Run syntax/import checks for every touched JS module.
9. Verify tabs, no compressed functions, B"H/Boruch Hashem/Blessed is He, Awtsmoos, and Awtsmoos.com in every touched human-authored source file.
10. Browser-test the mobile director at a narrow viewport using native tunnel Chrome control.
11. Run the canonical 180-second browser export.
12. ffprobe the produced file for duration, dimensions, streams, and codecs.
13. Extract frames near 5/35/65/95/125/155/175 seconds and compare hashes/statistics for visible diversity.
14. Inspect browser console/runtime errors during generation and export.
15. Re-read every touched source file completely.
16. Compare planned versus actual and write FIRST_PASS_DELTA.
17. Resolve every safe delta and rerun verification.
18. Search for hidden tests/importers/documentation and close remaining shadow work.
19. Empty REMAINING_WORK only when implementation, runtime proof, and final evidence all close.

## NEXT_ACTION
Write the source-only canonical export bridge and browser proof page, then freeze source first draft before tests.
